messages:
Mei: Hi team, putting my resignation in today. Last day will be 2026-10-22. Quick list: 1) Will health/dental/vision and 401k contributions stop on last day or month-end? 2) I have a conference travel reimbursement pending (flight booked, receipt ready) 10/18-10/202 - will that be reimbursed after exit? 3) My parking permit and building badge return logistics? Also curious about any pro-rated equity vesting for partial month. Thanks.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks Mei 1 congrats and sorry to see you go. Benefits: medical/dental/vision remain active through the last day of the month of termination. You'll get the COBRA packet within 14 days if you're eligible. 401k: employer contributions cut off based on payroll period; Priya can confirm exact cutoff. Equity: vesting is governed by the grant docs 1 typically vesting is based on calendar days and any proration depends on the plan; I'll pull the equity admin note and DM you.
Priya (Payroll): Hi Mei 1 final payroll: earned wages + eligible PTO payout processed on the next pay cycle after termination. 401k employee deferrals stop as of the last payroll that processes before termination; employer match timing varies by plan but usually matches per-pay-period. For the conference reimbursement: please submit the expense report ASAP (expense portal) and tag it as "post-termination reimbursement"; we can process up to 30 days after exit if receipts are within policy.
Mei: Thanks. I submitted the expense report just now and attached the flight/receipt. Any special routing I should use for approvers since Lina will be acting as coverage?
Lina (Manager): I'll approve the expense while you're still active and will sign off post-termination if needed. Mei, please add the project charge codes in the expense form so finance can route correctly. I'll also confirm which line items go to the hiring budget vs. R&D.
Sam (IT): IT note: we'll schedule deprovision at 5pm PT on your last day unless you request earlier. Please hand over any YubiKeys, access tokens in the handoff doc and transfer any service ownership in GitHub to Lina. Also remove personal SSH keys from the jumpbox before EOD.
Facilities: We'll provide a pre-paid return envelope for the parking hangtag and laptop if you need shipping. If you prefer in-person drop-off, stop by reception before 4pm on 10/22 and we'll log the return. Badge deactivation is currently set to last-day 17:00 PT; let us know if you need limited access for equipment pickup.
Mei: I'll drop the badge at reception on 10/22 at 11am. I need access to the office on 10/23 morning to collect personal items from my locker 1 is that possible?
Ava (People Ops): We generally disable badge access on the last day. For one-off post-exit access, we can issue a temporary visitor pass coordinated with Facilities and Lina. Request it here with dates/times and we'll log it.
Priya (Payroll): One more payroll note: taxable withholdings on final check follow your current W-4 settings. If your expense reimbursement is taxable (it usually isn't for travel receipts) it will be itemized separately.
Mei: Appreciate it. Also is there any paperwork I need to sign for equity or separation agreement?
Ava (People Ops): If there's a separation or retention clause it would be sent by legal/comp-admin. I don't see an active separation agreement on file for you. I'll confirm and DM you.
Lina (Manager): Mei, please finalize the handoff doc with service owners and the on-call rota. I'll take over triage for two weeks and then we'll redistribute.
Mei: Done 1 handoff doc updated, expense submitted, badge return scheduled. Thanks everyone.
Ava (People Ops): Checklist summary: benefits active until month-end; COBRA packet to personal email within 14 days; 401k/401k match timing confirmed by Priya; expense route confirmed; Facilities return options provided; IT deprovision scheduled at 17:00 PT last day; equity/legal follow-up pending. We'll send calendar invites for the exit interview and laptop pickup label. :white_check_mark:
